name: advisor-root
description: AI Framework Advisor Agent POC — workspace root

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=data && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=data && npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=cli
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=shared --if-present && npm run clean --workspace=data --if-present && npm run clean --workspace=api --if-present && npm run clean --workspace=cli --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=api && npm run test --workspace=eval
scripts.regression: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run regression --workspace=cli
